notes.title: Update v0.2.0 (May 29, 2025)
notes.content:
Changes:

 fixed vertical door pushing the player to the floor below in some edge cases
 reduced enemy back detection distance
 increased enemy detection time range from 200-300ms to 250-350ms
 implemented 1.5x slower enemy detection time when approaching them from the back
